body:
Sounds like AOTAutograd is not properly checking that dtypes are properly differentiable. @bdhirsh I'm assigning this to you, but please holler if you don't have bandwidth.

I'm not marking this high priority because it's a weird thing to have an integer tensor with requires_grad=True.

It's impossible to have integer tensor with `requires_grad=True`, so that's not it, this is `clamp` not doing correct type promotion which I still haven't fixed lol https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/93784 (because yeah it's weird to have clamp boundaries of a higher type than clamp inputs)
